high_level_description: This image is a movie poster for the film "Yudh." The poster features a man with a dramatic and intense expression. He has dark, curly hair and is wearing a white shirt. His hands are covered in what appears to be blood, and he is holding a small object, possibly a bullet or a similar item, between his fingers. Another hand, also covered in blood, is holding a gun near his head. The background is predominantly red, which adds to the intense and violent mood of the poster. The title "युध्दा" (Yudh) is prominently displayed in bold, fiery red letters
